arxiv-1812-05001.title: Temporal Analysis of Entity Relatedness and its Evolution using Wikipedia and DBpedia
arxiv-1812-05001.creator: Narumol Prangnawarat, John P. McCrae, Conor Hayes
arxiv-1812-05001.description: A 2018 arXiv research paper by Narumol Prangnawarat, John P. McCrae, Conor Hayes. Many researchers have made use of the Wikipedia network for relatedness and similarity tasks. However, most approaches use only the most recent information and not historical changes in the network. We provide an analysis of entity relatedness using temporal graph-based approaches over different versions of the Wikipedia article link network and DBpedia, which is an open-source knowledge base extracted from Wikipedia.

arxiv-2203-09318.title: A New Analytical Approximation of the Fluid Antenna System Channel Due to space limitation, most of the proofs of theorems, propositions and corollaries have been omitted and they can be found in our technical report [ 1 ] .
arxiv-2203-09318.creator: Malek Khammassi 1 , Abla Kammoun 1 , Mohamed-Slim Alouini 1
arxiv-2203-09318.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Malek Khammassi 1 , Abla Kammoun 1 , Mohamed-Slim Alouini 1. Fluid antenna systems (FAS) are an emerging technology that promises a significant diversity gain even in the smallest spaces. It consists of a freely moving antenna in a small linear space to pick up the strongest received signal. Previous works in the literature provide a simple yet insightful parameterization of the FAS channel that leads to single-integral expressions of the probability of outage and various insights on the achievable performance.

arxiv-2206-05081.title: The Evolution Of Centralisation on Cryptocurrency Platforms
arxiv-2206-05081.creator: Carlo Campajola, Raffaele Cristodaro, Francesco Maria De Collibus, Tao Yan, Nicolò Vallarano, Claudio J. Tessone
arxiv-2206-05081.description: Abstract More than ten years ago the blockchain was acclaimed as the solution to overcome centralised trusted third parties for online payments. Through the years the crypto-movement changed and evolved, although decentralisation remained the core ideology and the necessary feature every new crypto-project should provide.

arxiv-2208-13084.title: The phase structure and effective action of 3D CDT at higher spatial genus
arxiv-2208-13084.creator: Joren Brunekreef, Dániel Németh
arxiv-2208-13084.description: Abstract We perform a detailed investigation of the phase structure and the semiclassical effective action of (2+1)-dimensional Causal Dynamical Triangulations (CDT) quantum gravity using computer simulations. On the one hand, we study the effect of enlarging the ensemble of triangulations by relaxing the simplicial manifold conditions in a controlled way.

arxiv-2301-02110.title: FICE: Text–Conditioned Fashion Image Editing With Guided GAN Inversion
arxiv-2301-02110.creator: Martin Pernuš, Clinton Fookes, Vitomir Štruc, Simon Dobrišek
arxiv-2301-02110.description: Abstract Fashion–image editing represents a challenging computer vision task, where the goal is to incorporate selected apparel into a given input image. Most existing techniques deal with this task by first selecting an example image of the desired apparel and then transferring the clothing onto the target person. Such techniques are commonly referred to as Virtual Try-On methods.

arxiv-2306-11218.title: Kramers’ degenerate magnetism and superconductivity
arxiv-2306-11218.creator: Adil Amin, Hao Wu, Tatsuya Shishidou, Daniel F. Agterberg
arxiv-2306-11218.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Adil Amin, Hao Wu, Tatsuya Shishidou, Daniel F. Agterberg. Motivated by the recent discovery of odd-parity multipolar antiferromagnetic order in CeRh 2 ​ As 2 \text{CeRh}_{2}\text{As}_{2} , we examine the coexistence of such translation invariant Kramers’ degenerate magnetic states and superconductivity. We show that the presence of such magnetic states generically suppresses superconductivity, whether it be spin-singlet or spin-triplet, unless the magnetic state drives a symmetry-required pair density wave (PDW) superconducting order.

arxiv-2404-10814.title: Higher Hall conductivity from a single wave function: Obstructions to symmetry-preserving gapped edge of (2+1)D topological order
arxiv-2404-10814.creator: Ryohei Kobayashi, Taige Wang, Tomohiro Soejima (副島智大), Roger S. K. Mong (蒙紹璣), Shinsei Ryu
arxiv-2404-10814.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ryohei Kobayashi, Taige Wang, Tomohiro Soejima (副島智大), Roger S. K. Mong (蒙紹璣), Shinsei Ryu. A (2+1)D topological ordered phase with U(1) symmetry may or may not have a symmetric gapped edge state, even if both thermal and electric Hall conductivity are vanishing. It is recently discovered that there are “higher” versions of Hall conductivity valid for fermionic fractional quantum Hall (FQH) states, which obstructs symmetry-preserving gapped edge state beyond thermal and electric Hall conductivity.

arxiv-2406-13905.title: Persuasiveness of Generated Free-Text Rationales in Subjective Decisions: A Case Study on Pairwise Argument Ranking
arxiv-2406-13905.creator: Mohamed Elaraby, Diane Litman, Xiang Lorraine Li, Ahmed Magooda
arxiv-2406-13905.description: Abstract Generating free-text rationales is among the emergent capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). These rationales have been found to enhance LLM performance across various NLP tasks. Recently, there has been growing interest in using these rationales to provide insights for various important downstream tasks.

arxiv-2510-16793.title: Random convex chains through the lens of analytic combinatorics
arxiv-2510-16793.creator: Florian Besau and Christoph Thäle
arxiv-2510-16793.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Florian Besau and Christoph Thäle. Consider the triangle T T with vertices ( 0 , 0 ) (0,0) , ( 0 , 1 ) (0,1) , and ( 1 , 0 ) (1,0) . The lower boundary of the convex hull of ( 0 , 1 ) (0,1) , ( 1 , 0 ) (1,0) , together with n n independent uniformly distributed random points in T T , is called a random convex chain and denoted by T n T_{n} .

arxiv-2512-12856.title: Forgetful but Faithful: A Cognitive Memory Architecture and Benchmark for Privacy - Aware Generative Agents
arxiv-2512-12856.creator: Saad Alqithami
arxiv-2512-12856.description: Abstract Generative agents must manage long - horizon memories under strict budget and privacy constraints. We present the Memory - Aware Retention Schema (MaRS), a cognitively inspired architecture that organizes episodic, semantic, social, and task memories as typed, provenance - tracked nodes with multiple indices for efficient retrieval.

britannica-1911-lauchstadt.title: Lauchstädt (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-lauchstadt.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-lauchstadt.description: Article 'Lauchstädt' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 16), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Saxony, on the Laucha, 6 m. of Merseburg by the railway to Schafstädt. It contains an Evangelical church, a theatre, a hydropathic establishment and several educational institutions, among which is an agricultural school affiliated to the university of Halle. Its industries include malting, vinegar-making and brewing. Lauchstädt was a popular watering-place in the 18th century, the dukes of Saxe-Merseburg often making it their summer residence.

pmc-11477269.title: Increased Activation Markers of Adaptive Immunity in Patients with Severe COVID-19
pmc-11477269.creator: Abdulelah Aljuaid, Hideaki Kato, David S Fedson
pmc-11477269.description: Introduction: COVID-19 is a pandemic disease and is widespread over the world. This disease shows a 5.1% mortality. The understanding of the disease has expanded rapidly in many areas, including virological, epidemiological, clinical, and management dimensions. To better understand the inflammatory and immune profiles that impact the pathogenesis and development of severe COVID-19 symptoms, further studies are essential.

pmc-11640139.title: Alu–Mediated Duplication and Deletion of Exon 11 Are Frequent Mechanisms of PALB2 Inactivation, Predisposing Individuals to Hereditary Breast–Ovarian Cancer Syndrome
pmc-11640139.creator: Diletta Sidoti, Valeria Margotta, Diletta Calosci, Erika Fiorentini, Costanza Bacci, Francesca Gensini, Laura Papi, Marco Montini
pmc-11640139.description: Simple SummaryLarge genomic rearrangements of the PALB2 gene, especially deletions and duplications, are associated with hereditary breast–ovarian cancer. This study investigates intronic breakpoints linked to rearrangements in PALB2 exon 11, which is crucial for understanding the mechanisms affecting patients with hereditary breast and ovarian syndrome.

pmc-11675849.title: Effects of Different Detraining Periods on the Physical Fitness of Older Adults with Cardiometabolic Risk Factors
pmc-11675849.creator: Mabel Diesel, Vanessa de Mattos Martini, Ian Takimoto Schmiegelow, Carlos Augusto de Sousa, Cíntia de la Rocha Freitas, Aline Mendes Gerage, Rodrigo Sudatti Delevatti
pmc-11675849.description: Objective: To verify the effects of two different detraining periods on the physical fitness of older adults with cardiometabolic risk factors. Methods: This observational study encompassed older individuals with cardiometabolic risk factors, who were assessed after two different detraining periods: 1 month (1DT) and 3 months (3DT).

pmc-11727759.creator: Peng Wang, Jiawei Han, Siyuan Wang, Yu Guo, Ingo Dierking
pmc-11727759.description: Flexible fibers, such as biomass particles and glass fibers, are critical raw materials in the energy and composites industries. Assemblies of the fibers show strong interlocking, non-Newtonian and compressible flows, intermittent avalanches, and high energy dissipation rates due to their elongation and flexibility.

pmc-13664870.title: ISG15 Is a Key Multidirectional Regulator of Cytosolic RNA- and DNA-Sensing Pathways and Type I Interferon Feedback Loops
pmc-13664870.creator: Maleana G. White, Sergey Iordanskiy
pmc-13664870.description: Activation of cytosolic RNA and DNA sensing pathways that normally recognize viral nucleic acids triggers the expression and release of type I interferons (IFN-I). This release drives the expression of interferon-stimulated genes (ISGs) that activate acute inflammation and counteract viral replication at various stages.
